findings.title: Hardcoded credential in Jenkinsfile
findings.evidence: Hardcoded credential value in Jenkinsfile — move it to the Jenkins credentials store and reference it by credentialsId
findings.fix: Move it to the Jenkins credentials store and reference it by credentialsId.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential in Jenkinsfile
findings.evidence: AWS access key ID in Jenkinsfile
findings.fix: Move it to the Jenkins credentials store and reference it by credentialsId.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential in Jenkinsfile
findings.evidence: Private key in Jenkinsfile — anyone with repo read access has it
findings.fix: Move it to the Jenkins credentials store and reference it by credentialsId.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential in Jenkinsfile
findings.evidence: Credentials in a curl -u user:pass argument — visible in the console log and in the process list
findings.fix: Move it to the Jenkins credentials store and reference it by credentialsId.

findings.title: Unguarded sh step in Jenkinsfile
findings.evidence: Groovy ${...} interpolated inside a double-quoted sh string — use single quotes and pass values via env
findings.fix: Use single-quoted sh strings; pass values via env.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential in Jenkinsfile
findings.evidence: Secret-like variable used with no withCredentials block in this Jenkinsfile — where does its value come from?
findings.fix: Move it to the Jenkins credentials store and reference it by credentialsId.

findings.title: Unguarded sh step in Jenkinsfile
findings.evidence: Groovy ${...} interpolated inside a multi-line double-quoted sh block — use single quotes and pass values via env
findings.fix: Use single-quoted sh strings; pass values via env.

findings.title: Unguarded sh step in Jenkinsfile
findings.evidence: Docker socket mounted into a build step — the step is root on the host
findings.fix: Use single-quoted sh strings; pass values via env.

findings.title: Jenkins input step without timeout
findings.evidence: input step without a timeout — a build can hang forever waiting for approval
findings.fix: Add timeout: time: 30, unit: 'MINUTES'.

findings.title: No permissions: block
findings.evidence: No permissions: block — the token scope depends on the repo default (often read+write on older repos)
findings.fix: Declare permissions: {contents: read} explicitly; do not depend on the repo default.

findings.title: workflow_run executes a downloaded artifact
findings.evidence: workflow_run job downloads an artifact and runs code in the same job — a poisoned artifact from the untrusted run executes here
findings.fix: Download one bounded artifact, validate it against a schema, never execute it directly.

findings.title: Unpinned first-party action
findings.evidence: First-party action actions/download-artifact@v4 is not pinned — tags move; pin to the full 40-char commit SHA
findings.fix: Pin to the full 40-char commit SHA.

findings.title: Unsecure workflow commands enabled
findings.evidence: ACTIONS_ALLOW_UNSECURE_COMMANDS=true re-enables the deprecated set-output / save-state commands — an injection primitive
findings.fix: Remove ACTIONS_ALLOW_UNSECURE_COMMANDS.

findings.title: permissions: write-all
findings.evidence: permissions: write-all — every scope is writable
findings.fix: Replace with contents: read; grant writes per job.

findings.title: Self-hosted runner with untrusted trigger
findings.evidence: Job build runs on a self-hosted runner under an untrusted trigger (pull_request_target) — a compromised step owns the host
findings.fix: Use GitHub-hosted runners for PR-triggered jobs.

findings.title: Unpinned first-party action
findings.evidence: First-party action actions/checkout@v4 is not pinned — tags move; pin to the full 40-char commit SHA
findings.fix: Pin to the full 40-char commit SHA.

findings.title: pull_request_target checks out PR head code
findings.evidence: actions/checkout ref=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }} checks out PR head code in a pull_request_target workflow
findings.fix: Split the workflow: untrusted code under pull_request, privileged work under workflow_run — never check out fork code in a pull_request_target job.

findings.title: Script injection via ${{ }} in run:
findings.evidence: Untrusted expression ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} interpolated in run: — it becomes shell code
findings.fix: Move the value to env: and reference "$VAR" in the script — never interpolate event data into run:.

findings.title: Unpinned third-party action
findings.evidence: Third-party action tj-actions/changed-files@v45 is not pinned — pin to the full 40-char commit SHA (see CVE-2025-30066)
findings.fix: Pin to the full 40-char commit SHA, keep the version as a # vX.Y.Z comment. (tj-actions, CVE-2025-30066: attackers rewrote version tags and 23,000+ repos ran malicious code.)

findings.title: Action name is a typosquat of a well-known action
findings.evidence: uses: actions/checkou@eef61447b9ff4aafe5dcd4e0bbf5d482be7e7871 is very close to the well-known action actions/checkout — possible typosquat
findings.fix: Use the exact official action name; verify the owner/repo on the action's official page before trusting it.

findings.title: Unpinned third-party action
findings.evidence: Docker action docker://alpine:3.19 is not pinned by digest — use docker://image@sha256:<digest>
findings.fix: Pin to the full 40-char commit SHA, keep the version as a # vX.Y.Z comment. (tj-actions, CVE-2025-30066: attackers rewrote version tags and 23,000+ repos ran malicious code.)

findings.title: Secret echoed to logs
findings.evidence: Secret-bearing variable echoed to logs: MY_TOKEN
findings.fix: Do not print secrets; remove the echo. If a value must be inspected, use ::add-mask:: before any command that might print it.

findings.title: Secret echoed to logs
findings.evidence: Secret interpolated directly in run: (echo ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}) — GitHub masks registered secrets, but substrings and encoded forms are not masked
findings.fix: Do not print secrets; remove the echo. If a value must be inspected, use ::add-mask:: before any command that might print it.

findings.title: Secret echoed to logs
findings.evidence: printenv/env dumps the whole environment including secrets
findings.fix: Do not print secrets; remove the echo. If a value must be inspected, use ::add-mask:: before any command that might print it.

findings.title: Secret echoed to logs
findings.evidence: set -x prints every command with variables expanded — secrets leak into the log
findings.fix: Do not print secrets; remove the echo. If a value must be inspected, use ::add-mask:: before any command that might print it.

findings.title: Secret echoed to logs
findings.evidence: Secret piped through an encoder (echo $MY_TOKEN | base64) — encoded forms bypass GitHub's log masking
findings.fix: Do not print secrets; remove the echo. If a value must be inspected, use ::add-mask:: before any command that might print it.

findings.title: Secret echoed to logs
findings.evidence: Secret-bearing variable echoed to logs: MY_TOKEN
findings.fix: Do not print secrets; remove the echo. If a value must be inspected, use ::add-mask:: before any command that might print it.

findings.title: Remote script execution (curl | sh)
findings.evidence: Remote script piped straight into a shell (curl https://example.com/install.sh | sh) — download it, verify its hash, then run the local copy
findings.fix: Download the script, verify its hash, then run the local copy — never pipe a remote URL straight into a shell.

findings.title: pull_request_target checks out PR head code
findings.evidence: actions/checkout with no ref: in a pull_request_target workflow (checkout unpinned) — the safety of this depends on the checkout version
findings.fix: Split the workflow: untrusted code under pull_request, privileged work under workflow_run — never check out fork code in a pull_request_target job.

findings.title: Unpinned first-party action
findings.evidence: First-party action actions/checkout@v4 is not pinned — tags move; pin to the full 40-char commit SHA
findings.fix: Pin to the full 40-char commit SHA.

findings.title: Checkout persists credentials + artifact upload
findings.evidence: Job package: checkout persists the GITHUB_TOKEN and the job uploads an artifact — the token can end up in the artifact
findings.fix: Set persist-credentials: false on the checkout step.

findings.title: Unpinned first-party action
findings.evidence: First-party action actions/upload-artifact@v4 is not pinned — tags move; pin to the full 40-char commit SHA
findings.fix: Pin to the full 40-char commit SHA.

findings.title: Workflow-level write permission
findings.evidence: Workflow-level contents: write — every job gets this write scope; move it to the one job that needs it
findings.fix: Move the write scope to the job that needs it.

findings.title: Workflow-level write permission
findings.evidence: Workflow-level issues: write — every job gets this write scope; move it to the one job that needs it
findings.fix: Move the write scope to the job that needs it.

findings.title: id-token: write outside deploy job
findings.evidence: Job build: id-token: write mints OIDC tokens — restrict it to the deploy job
findings.fix: Restrict id-token: write to the deploy job.

findings.title: Unpinned third-party action
findings.evidence: Third-party action myorg/shared-workflows@v1 is not pinned — pin to the full 40-char commit SHA (see CVE-2025-30066)
findings.fix: Pin to the full 40-char commit SHA, keep the version as a # vX.Y.Z comment. (tj-actions, CVE-2025-30066: attackers rewrote version tags and 23,000+ repos ran malicious code.)

findings.title: secrets: inherit exposes all secrets
findings.evidence: Job call-shared calls myorg/shared-workflows/.github/workflows/shared.yml with secrets: inherit — every secret goes to the called workflow; pass only the ones it needs
findings.fix: Pass only the secrets the called workflow needs, by name — never secrets: inherit.

findings.title: pull_request_target without checkout
findings.evidence: Workflow runs on pull_request_target with secrets, but checks out nothing — any run: step touching github.event.* data is still exposed
findings.fix: Prefer pull_request unless you need secrets; keep the job free of PR-controlled data.

findings.title: Script injection via ${{ }} in run:
findings.evidence: Untrusted expression ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} interpolated in run: — it becomes shell code
findings.fix: Move the value to env: and reference "$VAR" in the script — never interpolate event data into run:.
